episodes.h: DEMS EXPOSE ISRAEL??? Democrats DEMAND Israel Nuclear Disclosure
episodes.blurb: He covers the House Democrats' letter demanding the US acknowledge Israel's nuclear arsenal, arguing the secrecy helps Israel and undermines Iran diplomacy, and says he is voting Democrat as leverage and punishment of the GOP.

episodes.blurb: He covers the Iran ceasefire strained by a US-Iran blockade clash, arguing a real peace is unlikely, and argues for voting Democrat in 2026 and an open 2028 primary, saying Vance, Rubio and the center-right are the right's biggest obstacle.
